svg.title: Capture creates both records before approved absorption; primary evidence and retention are separate
svg.desc: Research reports in output and meeting records in their configured folder carry proposed rows into authority checks and absorb. Wiki compilation reads selected primary evidence and supports direct authorized scope. Terminal research reports are excluded references; separately authorized transcript filing preserves primary sources. Meeting records stay in place.
svg.text: Capture → review → approved execution; retention follows terminal rows

g.aria-label: Workflow role and line legend
g.text: Legend: workflow roles, not running/completed status
Shapes/colors: violet rounded = command; neutral fold = record; blue double-edge = store; amber diamond = control; neutral pill = input
Solid → record / read / create · Dashed → authorized execution or terminal retention · Dotted → selected PRIMARY evidence

svg.text: 2 · Approved routes and independent compiler scope

g.aria-label: SOURCE INPUT: Question + sources; primary sources, not a report
COMMAND: Research capture; research-topic / research-sources
RECORD: Research report; output/ · proposed rows
SOURCE INPUT: Meeting inputs; transcript · event · notes
COMMAND: meeting-capture; configured template
RECORD: Meeting record; meetings/ default · proposed rows
CONTROL: Row approval; required facts satisfied
COMMAND: absorb; only approved rows
COMMAND: absorb; same command as above
STORE: Local destinations; docs · context · projects · tasks · writing
SOURCE INPUT: Primary raw evidence; source text + provenance
CONTROL: Compiler authority; direct scope authorized
COMMAND: wiki-compile; wiki enabled · selected subset
STORE: wiki/; synthesis + indexes
RECORD: Same research report; still in output/ while pending
CONTROL: All rows terminal; complete or declined
COMMAND: finalize; retain report + repair links
STORE: raw/derived/; excluded research report
SOURCE INPUT: Original transcript; policy-defined raw intake
CONTROL: Terminal + filing; separate authority
COMMAND: file-source; preserve bytes + repair links
STORE: Raw source archive; primary transcript · local policy

svg.text: Both records carry proposed rows. Existing authority carries through; pending facts or uncovered scope block execution.
Compiler scope may come from absorb or a direct authorized request. Reports are synthesis, never primary compiler evidence.
Meeting record: same path after processing. Repeated nodes show the same command/object in a detail panel.
Primary transcript archive ≠ excluded report archive. Pending rows retain intake/output; ingestion status is separate.
